xna-type.name: GamePadDeadZone
xna-type.summary: Specifies a type of dead zone processing to apply to Xbox 360 controller analog sticks when calling GetState.

member.name: Circular
member.summary: The combined X and Y position of each stick is compared against the dead zone. This provides better control than IndependentAxes when the stick is used as a two-dimensional control surface, such as when controlling a character's view in a first-person game.

member.name: IndependentAxes
member.summary: The X and Y positions of each stick are compared against the dead zone independently. This setting is the default when calling GetState.

member.name: None
member.summary: The values of each stick are not processed and are returned by GetState as "raw" values. This is best if you intend to implement your own dead zone processing.
